confirmedStartProposal.executionRequirement: This proposal does not lift the current no-immediate-run restriction. A live trial requires explicit permission for one exact target after lawful current-state readback; uncertain or failed requests are not retried.
confirmedStartProposal.supervision: Follow the actual run, source gate, signed candidate, validation, promotion, Pages bytes and all three account dates. Dispatch acceptance or check-start is never publication acceptance.
confirmedStartProposal.costBoundary: An early invocation adds one execution of the existing job and its normal metadata/secret/storage calls; no new service or ongoing IAM grant is configured here. Existing cost limits still apply.
